verdict.rationale: Fivetran documents a built-in AI Support Assistant in the dashboard that uses Fivetran documentation and known solutions to help resolve common issues. The evidence shows only troubleshooting help, not a general in-product assistant that performs tasks. The MCP server and coding-agent plugins are external agent integrations and do not count as a built-in assistant. Missing for 10: evidence the assistant can execute actions (create or modify connections, trigger syncs, configure pipelines), scope beyond support troubleshooting, detailed docs on its capabilities, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: The assistant uses Fivetran documentation and known solutions to help resolve common issues quickly, without waiting for a human support engineer.
For users on Free and Standard plans, it is the first point of contact before opening a support ticket.
